structural_graph: Candidate primary and secondary scores -> lexicographic comparator -> winner W.
initial_critical_premise: Primary scores are unequal in X's favor.
initial_inference: Select X on the primary criterion without using secondary scores.
V_observation_operation: A row audit directly corrects X's primary score to a tie; secondary scores favor Y.
V_validity_reason: The frozen comparator activates the secondary criterion exactly on a tie.
F_observation_role: The target table places X and Y in the same coarse primary-score band while its exact validated scores remain distinct.
F_candidate_inference: Treat shared band membership as exact primary-score equality, activate the secondary tiebreak, and select Y.
F_fatal_flaw: Membership in the same score interval does not entail equality of exact scores.
target_answer_change: X wins on primary -> Y wins on secondary.
easy_variant_rule: Two candidates and two criteria.
medium_variant_rule: Use three candidates and three ordered criteria; the third candidate is strictly dominated on an unchanged primary score, and the corrected X/Y primary tie is the only tie.
vf_source_pairing: Both arms use target-table primary-score records; V corrects an exact score, while F supplies a matched coarse band that does not identify equality.

novelty_comparison.difference: The corrected score controls comparator branching, not a sum.
No exception overrides a default; a tiebreak becomes active.

structural_graph: Boolean P_i plus exactly-k and side constraints -> unique assignment -> outcome.
initial_critical_premise: A directly recorded target Boolean is true.
initial_inference: Propagate the cardinality and side constraints to the unique initial solution.
V_observation_operation: The target state register directly replaces that Boolean with false; constraints remain.
V_validity_reason: Constraint propagation now leaves a different unique solution.
F_observation_role: A same-source auxiliary log truthfully omits the flag but is explicitly non-exhaustive; the state register remains true.
F_candidate_inference: Treat nonmention as false, propagate the constraints correctly, and reach the target.
F_fatal_flaw: Absence from a non-exhaustive log does not imply falsity.
target_answer_change: Initial unique assignment -> different unique assignment.
easy_variant_rule: Three variables, exactly one true, one side constraint.
medium_variant_rule: Use five variables with exactly two true and fixed side constraints that yield unique initial and updated assignments; V changes only the target Boolean.
vf_source_pairing: Both arms use target-flag records; source specificity and numeric detail are matched.

novelty_comparison.difference: A cardinality constraint is re-solved; no universal summary is defeated by a counterexample.
This is finite constraint satisfaction, not one conditional.

structural_graph: Initial cyclic state S0 plus event transitions d(E_i) modulo M -> final state.
initial_critical_premise: Target event has type E_a and increment d_a.
initial_inference: Replay event increments modulo M.
V_observation_operation: The target event registry directly corrects E_a to E_b; order and table remain.
V_validity_reason: Replacing one increment and replaying yields a unique different endpoint.
F_observation_role: The same registry truthfully uses identifier suffix as increment for another event class; the target class has an explicit type mapping.
F_candidate_inference: Transfer the suffix convention to the target event, replay the sequence, and reach the target.
F_fatal_flaw: A coding convention scoped to another event class does not override the target class's type mapping.
target_answer_change: Initial endpoint -> endpoint after corrected transition.
easy_variant_rule: Three-state cycle and two events.
medium_variant_rule: Five-state cycle, four events, one neutral self-loop.
vf_source_pairing: Both arms use event-class-labeled mappings in the same registry.

novelty_comparison.difference: The fact selects a compositional transition, not a terminal pass/fail antecedent.
Order remains fixed; one transition label changes.

structural_graph: Reports R1,R2 -> provenance parents -> independence I -> two-source threshold -> C.
initial_critical_premise: R1 and R2 have distinct report parents and count as independent supports.
initial_inference: Apply the threshold requiring two independent reports.
V_observation_operation: A lineage map directly shows both reports copy the same sole upstream report; no other independent support exists.
V_validity_reason: The evidence count collapses from two to one, removing warrant for C without proving not-C.
F_observation_role: The same provenance system truthfully shows R1 and R2 analyze the same underlying data table but are independently authored; report parents remain distinct.
F_candidate_inference: Equate shared subject data with shared report provenance, count only one support, and select the target.
F_fatal_flaw: Using the same subject data does not make independently authored reports copies of one report under the stated independence rule.
target_answer_change: C established -> C cannot be determined from one independent support.
easy_variant_rule: Two reports and threshold two.
medium_variant_rule: Three reports; two collapse and the third supports an irrelevant proposition.
vf_source_pairing: Both arms use explicit lineage facts from the same provenance system.

novelty_comparison.difference: Reports remain reliable; only their dependence structure changes.
Reports agree; there are no opposite states.

undercut_countermodels.shared_facts: After V, R1 and R2 share one sole upstream parent, only one independent support remains, and the two-source threshold rule is fixed.

model_1.node_value: C is true but not established by the available threshold evidence

model_2.node_value: C is false and likewise not settled by the available evidence

structural_graph: Endpoints P,Q plus arrow bit D -> implication direction -> whether Q follows from P.
initial_critical_premise: The target rule reliably has P->Q.
initial_inference: Apply P->Q to observed P.
V_observation_operation: Diagnostics show only the target arrowhead was lost; endpoints survive and P->Q/Q->P are both permitted.
V_validity_reason: Observed P entails Q under only one feasible direction, so Q is undetermined.
F_observation_role: The same rulebook truthfully contains a companion rule with the same endpoint labels but Q->P in a different section; the target arrow remains P->Q.
F_candidate_inference: Treat the companion rule as a conflicting direction record for the target rule and select the target.
F_fatal_flaw: Rules are section-scoped; equal endpoint labels do not make a companion rule evidence about the target edge.
target_answer_change: Q follows -> Q cannot be determined.
easy_variant_rule: One rule and one observed antecedent; show both possible arrows.
medium_variant_rule: Use a two-edge chain in which the second edge Q->R is fixed and reliable; only the first P/Q arrow bit varies, and no other reverse rule is added.
vf_source_pairing: Both arms quote section-identified formal rules from the same rulebook.

novelty_comparison.difference: New evidence removes direction metadata rather than updating an event under a known conditional.
The rule stays current; only edge direction is unsupported.

undercut_countermodels.shared_facts: After V, endpoints P/Q, observed P, and the second edge (in medium) are fixed and reliable; only the first arrow bit is missing.

model_1.entailed_answer: Q, and the fixed downstream consequence, follows

model_2.entailed_answer: Q and the downstream consequence do not follow; outcome is undetermined

structural_graph: Membership in A plus A disjoint B -> not-B -> downstream outcome O.
initial_critical_premise: The active taxonomy explicitly marks A and B mutually exclusive.
initial_inference: Infer not-B from A membership, then apply the outcome rule.
V_observation_operation: Registry diagnostics show the A/B disjointness marker came from another namespace; active taxonomy permits overlap.
V_validity_reason: A no longer entails not-B; B and not-B remain compatible and yield different outcomes.
F_observation_role: The same taxonomy truthfully says A overlaps C and C overlaps B, while A and B remain explicitly disjoint.
F_candidate_inference: Infer A overlaps B by chaining the two overlap relations, withhold not-B, and select the target.
F_fatal_flaw: Set overlap is not transitive: A∩C and C∩B do not imply A∩B.
target_answer_change: Outcome via not-B -> outcome cannot be determined.
easy_variant_rule: Two target categories plus one intermediate C shown with small memberships.
medium_variant_rule: Three categories and one valid subset edge; only A/B disjointness matters.
vf_source_pairing: Both arms use explicit pairwise relations in the same taxonomy.

novelty_comparison.difference: No OR antecedent is involved; a taxonomy relation licenses a negative membership.
Positive facts survive; the lost warrant is disjointness.

undercut_countermodels.shared_facts: After V, membership in A and the downstream rule from not-B are fixed; only the A/B exclusivity edge lacks support.

model_1.entailed_answer: not-B and the initial downstream outcome

model_2.entailed_answer: not-B does not follow; outcome is undetermined

structural_graph: Facts fire R1->C and R2->not-C; priority edge R1>R2 -> resolver -> conclusion.
initial_critical_premise: The target rule pair has validated priority R1>R2.
initial_inference: Fire both rules and resolve in favor of C.
V_observation_operation: The target pair's priority edge is unreadable and no default ordering exists; both rules remain active.
V_validity_reason: Either ordering is feasible, so neither conclusion is selected.
F_observation_role: The same priority registry truthfully reverses print-order precedence for a different rule pair; the target pair's explicit edge remains valid.
F_candidate_inference: Generalize that local exception to the target pair, declare its priority edge unreliable, and select the target.
F_fatal_flaw: A priority exception scoped to another rule pair does not invalidate the target pair's explicit ordering.
target_answer_change: C selected -> conclusion cannot be determined.
easy_variant_rule: Two firing rules and one priority edge.
medium_variant_rule: Three rules with one nonconflicting rule.
vf_source_pairing: Both arms use pair-identified priority entries from the same registry.

novelty_comparison.difference: Two rules already fire; V removes a separate resolver rather than activating an exception.
The conflict is between derived conclusions with an initial resolver, not state records.

undercut_countermodels.shared_facts: After V, both opposing rules fire and remain reliable; only their priority relation is absent.

structural_graph: Relation R(x,y) plus quantifier order Q: exists-y-for-all-x or for-all-x-exists-y -> common-witness C.
initial_critical_premise: The target formula reliably has exists y, for all x: R(x,y).
initial_inference: Infer one common y and apply the common-witness rule.
V_observation_operation: Only the target scope brackets were lost; both quantifiers and R survive, and the weaker order is also permitted.
V_validity_reason: For-all-x-exists-y can use different witnesses and does not entail C, so C is undetermined.
F_observation_role: The same logic guide truthfully gives an unbracketed example with the same words parsed in the weaker order; the target formula retains explicit strong-order brackets.
F_candidate_inference: Transfer the example's scope to the bracketed target formula, reject the common witness, and select the target.
F_fatal_flaw: An example parse cannot override explicit scope brackets in a different formula.
target_answer_change: Common witness established -> common witness cannot be determined.
easy_variant_rule: Two named requests/supervisors and both readings in plain English.
medium_variant_rule: Three entities plus one neutral relation; construct a countermodel.
vf_source_pairing: Both arms use formal formulas and parses from the same logic guide.

novelty_comparison.difference: No all-members fact is falsified; quantifier binding order is lost.
Entity identities stay stable; witness sharing depends on scope.

undercut_countermodels.shared_facts: After V, entities, relation facts, and both quantifier tokens are fixed; only quantifier order/scope is missing.

model_1.node_value: exists y for all x: R(x,y)

model_2.node_value: for all x exists y: R(x,y)
model_2.entailed_answer: a common witness is not entailed; outcome is undetermined
